summary: FreshRSS is a self-hostable feed aggregator designed to collect and organise web feed updates in one interface. It allows you to track content from various websites without relying on third-party subscription services. The application runs on your own hardware via PHP or Docker.
goodFor: It suits individuals who want to centralise their web reading habits and maintain complete control over their subscription data.
watchOut: You need to manage your own server infrastructure, updates, and backups, which creates an ongoing maintenance overhead compared to managed reading services.
deployNotes: You will typically need to configure persistent storage for your feed data and set up a reverse proxy with TLS termination for secure access.
